recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-46336 unless a later work-group decision chooses to harmonize link formatting across request-resource introduction pages.
issue_request: FHIR-46336 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 clarification asking DeviceRequest to add text that it represents an authorization for a device to be provided, that fulfillment details are handled by Task, and that implementers should refer to the Fulfillment/Execution section of the Request pattern.
initial_application: The change was previously applied by explicit source commits 20ab238b88 and 86981fcbc4. The latter commit is in current history and added the exact DeviceRequest fulfillment paragraph to source/devicerequest/devicerequest-introduction.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-45872 is the supporting Applied Request-pattern decision that added the shared Fulfillment/Execution rationale and asked request resources to link to it. DeviceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, the Request pattern source contains the linked Fulfillment/Execution section, OO 2024-07-26 minutes record approval of FHIR-46336 by 7-0-1, and a relevant Zulip thread supports the same DeviceRequest authorization versus Task fulfillment split.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active DeviceRequest introduction already includes the requested paragraph and link to the Request-pattern Fulfillment/Execution guidance, and no later evidence showed a semantic gap requiring another edit.
